answer.title: In adults with heart failure and preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF), do SGLT2 inhibitors reduce heart failure hospitalisation compared with placebo?
answer.headline: The evidence that SGLT2 inhibitors reduce heart failure hospitalisation in HFpEF is strong and comes principally from EMPEROR-Preserved, the first trial to show a favourable outcome effect in this population.
